build_model_instance: build a new metaseq model instance by implementing the build_model class method with args and task
prepare_model_for_inference: prepare the BaseModel for inference by calling prepare_for_inference_ with a DictConfig generation config
extract_decoder_features: extract features from source tokens by calling extract_features on the BaseModel decoder
get_normalized_probs: get normalized probabilities or log probabilities from the model net output using get_normalized_probs
optimize_generation_speed: optimize the model for faster generation by calling make_generation_fast_ to remove weight norms
